content.short: Rollkit is an open modular framework for sovereign rollups.
content.description: Rollkit is an open, modular framework for sovereign rollups that enables building rollups with interchangeable software components to preserve sovereignty. The project is in the MVP stage. It provides a centralized sequencer, an execution interface (ABCI or Cosmos SDK), and a data availability connection to Celestia. By supporting modular execution and data paths, Rollkit allows teams to mix and match components while maintaining governance over their rollup. It is designed for multi-chain use and welcomes contributions from builders across Cosmos, Ethereum, and beyond.
